experiment: Original MAP-KG relation-conditioned known-assertion content assay
prior_results_disclosed: Unconditioned molecule→protein known-target hit5 was 3/44; structural vote7/44 and popularity9/44. Initial explicit source-qualification agent arms tied12/12. This is a new mechanism-specific assay, not a revised interpretation of those results.
asset_scope: Original fine-tuned BioBERT text_encoder, original text_projector, GatedFusion, original gene projector/protein subset and original molecule cache. All222 original new tensors strict-loaded; 500MB additional partial-download budget. No full runtime or native response reconstruction.
authentication: Pinned source/model tokenizer metadata plus current official Drive file-ID, exact ZIP member size/CRC/localSHA256; full GB checkpoint digest unverified. Original molecule/projector cache reconstruction separately passed. No random replacement tensors or generic pretrained BioBERT weights substituted.
primary_queries: Every distinct (strict-qualified drugidentity, exact genericrelation) pair present in raw source rows for five registered phrases, with nonempty known targets. Thirty drug identities and32 pairs in fixed menu. All44 known-target identities and146 candidates retained as coverage; absent genericrelation queries flagged rather than generated.

generic_relations.phrase: functions as an inhibitor on the protein target
functions as an activator on the protein target
functions as an agonist on the protein target
functions as an antagonist on the protein target

exploratory_queries: All258 distinct drug+originalrelation pairs from162 verbatim relation phrases over44 identities. Target-naming or assay conditions in prose may provide answers; report only original-source content and relation-only baseline. No rewriting/removing target names after seeing ranks.
protein_gallery: Exact frozen1241 protein gallery:241 unambiguous menu known targets+1000 fixed global distractors,21 ambiguous target IDs excluded and retained in truth denominators. Target-enriched gallery, not genome-wide.
truth: For each drug+relation phrase, use exactly its raw original edge-target set. No target gene appears in the generic query text. Unknown/missing graph edges remain unknown; no heldout-edge or biological absence assertions.

official_composition.outgoing: GatedFusion(z_drug,z_relation) -> z_gene; public forward source-side conditioning uses this order.
official_composition.incoming: z_drug -> GatedFusion(z_relation,z_gene); public forward target-side conditioning uses this order, where the gate multiplies its SECOND argument.
official_composition.drug_space: Primary uses original knowledge1024 modality representation from molecular cache; canonical drug-name embedding secondary checks actual name anchors used by public edge dataloader.
official_composition.gene_space: Primary uses original projected protein1024 modality representation; canonical gene-name embedding secondary checks actual name anchors.
official_composition.relation_encoder: Original fine-tuned BioBERT pooler output followed by original text projector; official tokenizer max_length512, fixed maximum padding, special tokens, truncation and attention mask; eval dropout disabled. Original names/phrases, no invented TransE.
official_composition.direction_selection: All directions reported separately; never select the best direction after results.

control_detail.relation_permutation: Fixed RNG20261012 permutation of the sorted available generic phrase dictionary for generic queries; other exploratory phrases use a fixed permutation of the full162 dictionary. If a fixed point occurs retain it and report. No query truth relabeling.
control_detail.protein_permutation: Reuse fixed RNG20261010 full protein-row identity permutation.
control_detail.vote: Existing molecule256 cosine selects five other identities excluding sameCID/fullSMILES, before relation filtering; each donor votes once per known target with the EXACT queryrelation. No adaptive expansion to find annotated neighbors.
control_detail.popularity: Each other exact-qualified unique identity votes once per target for the EXACT queryrelation; query/sameCID/sameSMILES excluded.
control_detail.zero_controls: Stable gene-ID tie order; absence of donor assertion is no assertion, not experimental negative.
control_detail.relation_only: Same fine-tuned relation embedding; ranks same projected proteins without drug input to quantify semantic/target-naming content.

metrics.primary: Drug-macro known-assertion hit@5 for outgoing modality arm on generic32pairs, averaging relation-query hit per each of30 drugs and then drugs. Query-micro32 denominator also reported.
metrics.recall: All known targets for exactly that queryrelation, including absent/ambiguous gallery IDs. No denominator repair based on results.
metrics.ties: Descending score then ascending stable geneID, identical to frozen protein assay.
metrics.uncertainty: Descriptive per-query/paired counts; graph exposure and limited known-annotation endpoints preclude independent biological significance.

acceptance: Outgoing generic drug-macro hit5 must exceed relation-only, molecule-vote and query-excluded exactrelation popularity, with permutation metrics reported. Do not promote or claim relationconditioned method superiority from mixed results, nameanchor-only success or exploratory target-named phrases.
registration_note: Features/names/relations/source identities and compatibility outputs frozen before scoring. Protein-feature result is known; relation query endpoints were defined before relation scores.
limits: Target-enriched gallery and source-known annotation truth
Gene name encodings index the candidate gallery; canonical source names may be ambiguous, preserved in metadata
No RNA/function/risk/EVSI or agent policy benefit
Native response gene map and checkpoint matched forward remain blocked
